text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，持续加强煤炭稳产稳供，优化煤炭生产组织，科学安排采掘接续，有序释放先进产能。研究建立重点产煤省区协同生产机制，推动市场平稳运行。加强供需监测和生产调度，强化电煤保供中长期合同签订履约，高效开展区域互济、多能互补，提升迎峰度夏、迎峰度冬等重点时段顶峰保供能力。稳定“两湖一江”、东北、西南等重点地区煤炭供应，深化煤炭调入区与主产区供需衔接和战略合作，优化储煤基地建设布局，提高电厂存煤水平，突出保障民生用煤需求。
text_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which calls for continuing to strengthen stable coal production and supply, optimizing coal production organization, scientifically arranging mining and excavation succession, and orderly releasing advanced capacity. It studies establishing a coordinated production mechanism for key coal-producing provinces and regions to promote smooth market operations. It strengthens supply-demand monitoring and production scheduling, enhances medium- and long-term contract signing and performance for coal power supply assurance, efficiently carries out regional mutual support and multi-energy complementarity, and improves peak supply capacity for summer and winter demand peaks. It stabilizes coal supply in key regions like 'Two Lakes, One River' (Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi), Northeast, and Southwest, deepens supply-demand linkage and strategic cooperation between coal-importing regions and major producing areas, optimizes storage base layout, raises power plant coal inventory levels, and highlights guarantees for residential coal demand.
